div.head: II Ew 6
div.ab: Gyf hwa ðurh stæltihtlan freot forwyrce ⁊ his hand on hand sylle, ⁊ hine his magas forlætan, ⁊ he nite, hwa him forebete, ðonne sy he ðæs ðeowweorces wyrðe, ðe ðærto gebyrige; ⁊ oðfealle se wer ðam magum.

Gif hwa þurh stæltihtlan freot forwyrce ⁊ his hand on hand sylle, ⁊ hine his magas forlætan, ⁊ he nyte, hwa him forebete, ðonne sy he ðæs ðeowweorces wyrðe, ðe ðærto gebyrige; ⁊ oðfealle se wer ðam magum.

Si quis pro furti compellatione libertatem suam forisfaciat et manum suam in manum mittat, et parentes sui deserant eum, et nesciat, quis emendet pro eo, tunc sit dignus opere seruili, quod ad id pertinet; et excidat wera parentibus eius.

[Be ðon ðe his freot forwyrce.] [Ld] Gif hwa þurh stæltihtlan freot forwryce ⁊ his hand on hand sylle, ⁊ hine his magas forlætan, ⁊ he nyte, hwa him forebete, ðonne sy he ðæs ðeowweorces wyrðe, ðe ðærto gebyrige; ⁊ oðfealle se wer ðam magum.

If any man, through [being found guilty of] an accusation of stealing, forfeits his freedom and gives up his person to his lord, and his kinsmen forsake him, and he knows no one who will make legal amends for him, he shall do such servile labour as may be required, and his kinsmen shall have no right to his wergeld [if he is slain].

(Von dem, der seine Freiheit verwirkt. Ld) Wenn einer durch Diebstahlsprocess [schuldig] die Freiheit verwirkt und seine Person in [eines Herrn] Hand unterwirft — indem seine Verwandten ihn verlassen, und er nie[manden] weiss, wer für ihn [eintretend] Bussschuld zahle —, dann sei er so viel Sklavenarbeit schuldig, wie dazu gehört; und jenen Verwandten entgehe das Wergeld [wenn er erschlagen wird].

(Of him who forfeits his freedom. Ld) If anyone [found guilty] through a theft-suit forfeits his freedom and gives his person into [a lord's] hand — his kinsmen abandoning him, and he knowing no[body] who would pay the compensation [stepping in] for him —, then let him be liable for as much slave-labour as belongs to it; and let the wergild be lost to those kinsmen [if he is slain].
